english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is included or forms part of a whole.

exampleSentences.english: This set meal will include a drink and dessert.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個套餐包括飲品同甜品。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 tou3 caan1 baau1 kut3 jam2 ban2 tung4 tim4 ban2

english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for saying that a job, plan, or thing includes something.

exampleSentences.english: This job can involve meeting clients.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢份工作包括同客人開會。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 baau1 kut3 tung4 haak3 jan4 hoi1 wui6

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for saying that something includes particular parts or elements.

exampleSentences.english: This set menu can comprise a drink and a dessert.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢份套餐包括飲品同甜品。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ne1 fan6 tou3 caan1 baau1 kut3 jam2 ban2 tung4 tim4 ban2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for including things within a scope, including a complete range.

exampleSentences.english: This course is designed to encompass grammar, conversation, and writing.

english.meaning: include as part of a whole
english.note: Use this when something embodies something else by including it as one part of a larger whole.

exampleSentences.english: This course aims to embody grammar, conversation, and writing practice.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢套課程包括文法、會話同埋寫作訓練。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ne1 tou3 fo3 cing4 baau1 kut3 man4 faat3 wui6 waa2 tung4 maai4 se2 zok3 fan3 lin6

english.note: Use this when explicitly listing something as a component or included part.

exampleSentences.english: This set meal will contain a drink and dessert.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢份套餐包括飲品同甜品。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 tou3 caan1 baau1 kut3 jam2 ban2 tung4 tim4 ban2
